label: Cyclic partitioning
subgoals: Take the index modulo the factor for the bank
Take the integer quotient for the offset inside the bank
Prefer power-of-two factors so the address split is bit selection

label: Block partitioning
subgoals: Divide the array length by the number of banks and round up for the bank size
Divide the index by the bank size for the bank
Match block partitioning to parallel accesses that are far apart

label: Choosing the factor
subgoals: Count the parallel reads per cycle the schedule needs
Divide by the ports per bank and round up
Partition along the dimension the unrolled index walks
